root.label: White House forms committee to investigate Lisa Cook

events.label: White House forms committee to investigate Lisa Cook

slots.name: hearing date
slots.sentence: This newly-formed committee appears to be the process the White House has settled on to give Cook a chance to advocate for herself, as she will be allowed to submit a written statement ahead of her first scheduled hearing on Nov. 5, 2026.

slots.name: hearing length
slots.sentence: Her statement must be received by the committee at least three days ahead of the hearing, which will unfold at the White House and will last no more than four hours, according to a notice dated Wednesday, Oct. 7, 2026, but released on Friday by the Trump administration.
